lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary vertical alignment of three large, high-luminance circular spots is visible immediately posterior to the pectoral fin insertion, followed by a secondary column of four smaller nodes forming a loose grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transitioning from high-luminance upper pixels to a distinct shadow line below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct pinkish-red circular lesion or abrasion is visible on the upper cranial region, anterior to the first gill slit.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface displays a high density of small, irregularly distributed white spots that contrast with the larger, structured constellations on the main flank.
